subject: Can package 'lavaan' analyze multilevel moderated mediation model with binary outcomes?

messages.author: 49b31f5859efb99d
messages.subject: Can package 'lavaan' analyze multilevel moderated mediation model with binary outcomes?
parts:
I am a big fan of lavaan since it is more user-friendly compared with MPLUS to me.

I tried to use lavaan to analyze multilevel moderated mediation model with binary outcomes. However, according to the information available online, it seems that this cannot be handled by this package by far.

Can anyone help confirm whether my perception is accurate?

Thanks!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Can package 'lavaan' analyze multilevel moderated mediation model with binary outcomes?
parts:
Correct, lavaan cannot yet accommodate multilevel discrete data.
